verdict.rationale: Fellow documents org-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and shared, retention controls, and admin-level oversight via the Super Admin API (export/delete across workspace, act on behalf of users) plus MCP Server governance (admins enable/revoke, see last-used timestamps, and access is scoped to what a user already has). However there is no explicit evidence of private-by-default notes or granular link/folder-level permission controls, only workspace-level policy language. Missing for 10: explicit private-by-default note behavior, granular link/folder sharing permission settings, and a unified admin dashboard showing what's shared across the org.
